How can you save time while searching for strong stocks?

In this episode of Tuesday Technical Talk, Vishal B Malkan explains how traders can use stock scanners, RSI filters and AI automation to simplify the process of finding potential technical setups.

Instead of manually checking hundreds of charts every day, a structured scanner can help narrow down the list and allow traders to focus on analysis.

The session begins with a market overview of Nifty and Bank Nifty, followed by understanding how the current market condition affects trading decisions.

Vishal explains how:

Market → Scanner → Setup → Confirmation

can create a more organised workflow.

In this video, you will learn:

Vishal also explains that a scanner is not a replacement for analysis.

The purpose of a scanner is to reduce manual effort and help traders identify areas that deserve attention.

The process discussed includes:

• Monthly timeframe for broader direction
• Weekly timeframe for trend strength
• Daily timeframe for setup identification
• Additional confirmation through price action and volume

One of the key takeaways:

Technology should not replace your thinking — it should make your process faster, simpler and more organised.
